title: 16396 - 16396/P0012/000018
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Emme Camshaft Adjuster
When the Emme Camshaft Adjuster uses oil pressure to control the adjuster, Kontrol edin: the oil pressure.  The 1.8T is notorious for issues but any engine with low oil pressure or restrictions in the system could result in various timing DTC's such as 17748/P1340/004928.
Use Output Test, Meas. Value Blocks (MVB) & Basic Setting
